tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a legally registered entity in India and shall be engaged in the business of supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance of IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking equipment or related enterprise IT systems.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate issued under the Companies Act by a competent authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall submit valid OEM authorisation for the products offered, covering supply, installation, warranty, technical support and CAMC obligations. Where the bidder is the OEM, documentary evidence of its manufacturing/OEM status shall be submitted. The authorisation shall remain valid for the duration of the procurement and shall cover the contractual support obligations.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Authorization letter from OEM or Manufacturing Certificate should be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The firm or company should produce the self-attested photocopies of documents related to Company PAN Number and GST Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Detailed technical architecture or solution demonstrating proposed configuration, interoperability, sizing, redundancy, connectivity and compliance.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have an average annual turnover of not less than Rs.5,20,00,000 (Rupees Five Crore Twenty Lakh only) during the three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. Eligible MSME bidders shall be subject to the applicable relaxation, subject to submission of valid registration and supporting documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder or OEM shall have successfully executed supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance of enterprise IT infrastructure for Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, statutory bodies or other recognised organisations in India during the last five years.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Details of the service centres in India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and satisfactory certificates as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall submit a declaration that it has not been blacklisted or debarred by the Government of Karnataka, Government of India, any State Government/UT Administration or their agencies for corrupt, fraudulent, collusive or other serious misconduct affecting public procurement. Any existing or past debarment relevant to this declaration shall be disclosed in the prescribed format.

The bidder shall have an operational service support facility in Karnataka or shall establish such facility before commencement of the Contract. The bidder shall maintain adequate qualified technical personnel with at least 10 Nos. and service support arrangements to meet the response and resolution times specified in the SLA throughout the warranty and CAMC period. Details of the service centre, technical personnel and escalation matrix shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Technical product brochure is to be submitted and the same should be available on the OEMs or Vendors website.
Others -- Compliance statement of the specifications of the equipment as mentioned in this tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Detailed technical architecture and connectivity diagram
Item-wise supply and support period declaration
Land border sharing declaration, where applicable
Past experience work orders and completion / performance certificates
